📈 The cost of government borrowing just hit a 28-year high. The 30-year gilt yield briefly topped 6% on 1 October — the first time since 1998. 😬

Analysts reported by City AM say it could wipe around £9bn off the Chancellor's £23.6bn headroom, three weeks before the Budget on 28 October. The PM won't rule out tax rises. Working people can't keep paying the interest on a state that won't stop spending. 💷
